description: This file defines the internal class 'MembershipTableCleanupAgent' responsible for cleaning up dead membership entries in Orleans cluster. It manages timers, performs cleanup operations, and integrates with lifecycle and health check interfaces.

classes.name: MembershipTableCleanupAgent
classes.description: Handles cleanup of defunct silo entries in the Orleans cluster, manages timers, and participates in lifecycle and health check processes.

methods.name: MembershipTableCleanupAgent
methods.description: Constructor initializing options, logger, and timer for cleanup operations.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the cleanup timer if it exists.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSilos
methods.description: Performs periodic cleanup of defunct silo entries, handles exceptions, and manages jitter in cleanup scheduling.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes to lifecycle events to start and stop cleanup tasks.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Starts the cleanup task when lifecycle is active.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Stops cleanup timer and waits for ongoing cleanup task to complete.

methods.name: CheckHealth
methods.description: Checks the health status of the cleanup timer.
